title: GBRG Supply-Chain Operational-Risk Proof Artifact
description: Governance-native result of a supply-chain operational-risk assessment over the governed blast-radius graph, at node | path | cluster granularity. Extends the estate-canonical ProofArtifact v1 (never a bare number): carries the declared weights reference, the inherent/control/residual scores, the rating, the controls-evidence set, and the KRI/KCI evaluations that justify the verdict.
$comment: Converged onto the estate-canonical ProofArtifact v1 (standards-storage#97, remediation R2): binds via allOf to https://schemas.socioprophet.ai/proof-artifact/v1.json and $refs its epistemicLevel enum from $defs instead of copy-pasting it. Weights live in supply-chain-risk-weights.v0.json (declared, not magic numbers). epistemicLevel is the proof-CONFIDENCE axis: an assessment whose claimed control efficacy is fully evidenced and whose KRIs are all within threshold is 'empirical'; an assessment with any unevidenced control-family claim, or any KRI in the RED band, is FAILED/BLOCKED and downgraded (fail-closed on missing evidence / threshold breach).

riskScope.description: Granularity of this assessment: a single graph node, a critical-service path (chain of nodes), or a common-mode concentration cluster.

subjectId.description: Identifier of the assessed node / path / cluster (e.g. an ontology node type instance, path id, or cluster id).

inherentScore.description: Weighted inherent risk (node) or common-mode inherent (cluster). Absent for a path, whose risk is accumulated from node residuals.

controlEfficacy.description: Weighted control-family efficacy (0..1). Only families whose claim is EVIDENCED count; see controlsEvidence.

residualScore.description: Node: inherent*(1-controlEfficacy). Path: 1 - product(1 - residual_i). Cluster: common_mode_inherent*(1-resilience).

rating.description: Rating band from residualScore per the declared rating_thresholds.

weightsRef.description: URN/id of the declared weights document the scores were computed under (supply-chain-risk-weights.v0).

crosswalkRefs.description: Alignment ids (e.g. B001, F003) binding this assessment's control taxonomy to BIAN/FICO via the governed crosswalk.

controlsEvidence.description: Per-control-family evidence records. A control family with efficacy > 0 MUST carry a non-empty evidenceRef here, or the assessment fails closed (unverifiable control claim).

evidenceRef.description: Pointer to the evidence backing this control-family claim. null/empty with efficacy>0 = unverifiable => fail-closed.

kriEvaluations.description: Evaluated KRIs/KCIs relevant to this subject. Any band == 'red' is a threshold breach that FLAGS the assessment.

verdict.description: Assay-style projection: VERIFIES (ok) = evidenced controls + all KRIs within threshold; FLAGGED (sad) = a KRI in RED / threshold breach; REJECTED (bad) = missing/unverifiable controls-evidence or an ungoverned crosswalk term.

derivation.description: Human-readable explanation of WHY this rating/verdict holds (which factors, controls, KRIs, and crosswalk terms were considered).

declared_by.description: Producing agent identity, resolvable in the agent-registry.
